follow-up time: From 26-28 weeks of gestation until planned cesarean delivery between 32 and 35 weeks of gestation
exposure: Antenatal surveillance strategies (inpatient vs. intensive outpatient follow-up)
finding: For monoamniotic twin pregnancies, the in utero risk of death for a fetus exceeds the risk of a postnatal nonrespiratory complication at 32 4/7 weeks of gestation, and if close fetal surveillance is instituted after 26-28 weeks of gestation and delivery takes place at approximately 33 weeks of gestation, the risk of fetal or neonatal death is low, regardless of the surveillance setting.
